shape.parent: the widget that receives the fragment (a screen: its Content)
shape.html: the fragment inline, instead of file

(html element).rule: Tag = the tag, class -> extended property; any tag of the platform's HTML Element (api --op html, platformTags), tables too; br: an empty Container

form.rule: class -> Style; children are its content

(literal text).rule: no class of its own; a space next to an inline element stays

i.rule: icon = the icon name; weight is mandatory

input.rule: bind names an existing variable, placeholder -> Prompt, type text|password|number|time|date|datetime-local|tel|email|search; the bound data type decides the InputType

select.rule: bind -> Variable, options -> List, value -> Values, label -> Labels; value and label read the element of options by its attributes (Item.Id for an aggregate over Item, Id for a list of records), never options.Current

button.rule: onclick (or href): an action or screen, Name(args) or :Input passes inputs; children are its content; empty with aria-label/title

label.rule: for -> TargetWidget (an input id of the fragment); with child elements: an HTML Element label with them

div[list].rule: Source = list; as is mandatory and names the row inside {{ }}

div[if].rule: children: True branch; a <div else> right after: False branch

Block.rule: name = an existing block, inputs by :Name, handlers by @Event, children by <slot name>

ButtonGroup.rule: bind -> Variable; each <ButtonGroupItem value> an IButtonGroupItem, its text an Expression; also written <button-group> and <button-group-item>

switch.rule: bind names an existing Boolean variable

upload.rule: bind -> FileContent (a Binary Data variable), filename -> FileName

style.rule: scoped under the root class; light-dark() expanded, @keyframes kept, @import to the top

attributes: any other attribute: an IExtendedProperty, {{ }} makes an expression
names: id: name, alias $id; else Tag1, Tag2; Block none
rejected: a name that does not exist in the module
